description: The Korea Transport Database (KTDB, 국가교통DB) is the national transport database programme run by the Korea Transport Institute (KOTI) in Sejong. Its data request page states that the databases built under the programme are provided free of charge, under Article 17-3 of the National Integrated Transport System Efficiency Act, to public bodies, research institutes, companies, academics and general users. Two kinds of data are listed: transport analysis data (passenger O/D, freight O/D, trip generation rates, traffic volumes, transport analysis networks and transport thematic map data) and raw survey data (household travel survey, weekend travel survey, passenger facility use survey, car use survey, mode use survey and truck travel survey). The transport facility survey built GIS thematic maps of road nodes, links and turn restrictions and of rail nodes and links each year from 2002, added public transport routes in 2013, and since 2014 has been built from commercial navigation data. The site also holds a transport statistics database and yearbook. Coverage is national. Format and access: files downloaded after choosing the data and filling in an application form with the purpose of use; statistics on the web. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the site is in Korean and often reset connections from the cloud; which years each O/D set covers was not checked. Simulation uses: national demand models, network assignment and freight flow analysis. Related records: complements the KORAIL railway data portal.
